item.description_tr:
🎧 K20 Ear Clip Open-Ear TWS Bluetooth Headphones
✨ MAIN CHARACTERISTICS
✅ Large 13mm Drivers, 360 surround sound° And full-bodied bass
☁️ Ergonomic ear clip, lightweight and comfortable for long time use
🔇 Optimized sound technology, reduces leaks for private listening
⚡ Bluetooth 5.4, fast pairing and low latency for gaming
🔋 Case with LED digital display, up to 25 hours of playback
🎨 Colors: Matte Black, Apricot, Purple

🌍 Usage Scenarios
🚶 Urban Routine | 🏃 Outdoor Activities | 🎵 Music | 📞 Work Calls | 🎮 Furniture Games

📦 Package Contents
1 * Pair of K20 Ear Clip Headphones
1 * Charging Case with LED digital display
1 * Type-C Charging Cable
1 * User Manual

❓ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Q: How to use the headphones for the first time?
A: Charge the headphones for 30 minutes before first use.
